mechanism_analysis_synthesis_destruction.method: re-scored every captured pre-synthesis attempt/councillor response (mechanism_calls, full text) against the real sandboxed ground truth, zero new model calls

illustrative_examples.description: all 3 same-model attempts (temp 0.55/0.7/0.85) independently produced a complete, correct ThreadSafeMultiCounter class; synthesis kept only the __main__ demo block and dropped the class definition entirely, failing with NameError

all 3 heterogeneous councillors (qwen2.5-coder:7b, mlx:qwen3, echo:latest) produced byte-for-byte identical correct code for find_missing(); synthesis fabricated an unprompted 'n = len(nums) - 1' not present in any input, breaking correct logic with zero real disagreement to reconcile

compute_budget.reasoning: the oracle-vs-synthesis gap (15.5-28.6pp) is an order of magnitude larger than any plausible effect from one extra content-discarded call, and was established via re-scoring already-generated text with zero new model calls -- judged not to be where the explanatory power lies, so further real compute was not spent chasing it

h1_h4_verdicts.note: the model's own ceiling is not the binding constraint; the synthesis step's reliability is -- a more specific mechanistic claim than H2's original framing

h1_h4_verdicts.statement: apparent Council advantage is compute/diversity not orchestration
h1_h4_verdicts.note: refined: heterogeneous-model synthesis is measurably harder (loses 28.6pp) than same-model synthesis (loses 15.5pp), a specific mechanism rather than a generic diversity/compute story

h1_h4_verdicts.statement: self-edit framing hurts general coding performance vs bare prompting

what_this_establishes: the Tier-3 pilot's 37.5pp gap was substantially inflated by small-sample noise; the confirmatory pooled estimate is 11.9pp and not statistically significant
the direction of the pilot finding replicated across 3 independent samples; the magnitude did not
the underlying model pool's raw generative capability is high (95-96% oracle) and is not the binding constraint on any arm
synthesis/combination is the primary, quantified bottleneck, worse for heterogeneous Council synthesis (28.6pp lost) than same-model BASE_N synthesis (15.5pp lost)
Echo's self-edit generation framing measurably and significantly hurts general coding performance relative to bare prompting (p=0.0002)
the evaluator held up cleanly at 10x pilot scale with zero infrastructure failures or truncations
what_this_does_not_establish: that Council orchestration is never useful on any task class or council composition
a full resolution of the model-diversity-vs-orchestration confound (H4's original boundary) -- the mechanism is located, not fully attributed to diversity as a principle
that the synthesis defect is unfixable
anything about Echo's literal production self-edit call path or multi-turn/non-coding performance
an isolated measurement of the temperature-vs-synthesis-defect confound for BASE_1 vs BASE_N/ARCH_COUNCIL -- named but not separated by a dedicated sub-experiment

recommendation.rationale: the oracle analysis proves the raw ingredients for a much better result (95-96% capability) already exist inside every real execution; the specific combination/synthesis mechanism is where that capability is measurably lost, worse for the more architecturally elaborate arm
next_steps: a targeted synthesis-prompt or synthesis-procedure fix aimed at code-completeness (e.g. a post-synthesis completeness/structure check)
re-test the corrected synthesis mechanism against a fresh, disjoint, third task suite before declaring the fix successful
resolve the temperature confound directly via a targeted sub-experiment (BASE_N at temperature 0.0)
separately decide whether to address ARCH_PIPELINE_ISOLATED's self-edit-framing penalty (p=0.0002, strong enough to act on now)
